description: This file defines a minimal API endpoint class for listing catalog brands in an e-commerce web application. It registers a GET route at 'api/catalog-brands', retrieves catalog brand data from a repository, maps entities to DTOs using AutoMapper, and returns the data in a response object.

classes.name: CatalogBrandListEndpoint
classes.description: Defines a minimal API endpoint for listing catalog brands, including route registration and handler method.

methods.name: AddRoute
methods.description: Registers the HTTP GET route 'api/catalog-brands' for retrieving catalog brands.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the request by fetching catalog brands from the repository, mapping them to DTOs, and returning the result.
